units.result: record [5.705, 50.255]  reader [5.63, 50.24]  6 km  ok  note: Plain (US) division box with armor oval, labeled 2, just north of the front line on the bulge north shoulder, beside the 84 box.

record [5.56, 50.195]  reader [5.44, 50.22]  9 km  ok  note: Dashed (British) division box near Marche. Only the digit 5 is legible; the second digit appears hidden under the thick purple 5.5E grid line. No other dashed box near it, so this is very likely 51, but the number is not fully readable.
record [5.56, 50.287]  reader [5.53, 50.26]  4 km  ok  note: Plain division box with infantry X, labeled 84 (+/-), just west of 2 Armored.

readerNotes.line: Traced from the heavy ticked line: enters at the top near Geilenkirchen, east along about 51.0N, down the Roer past Dueren and Monschau, west along the north shoulder of the bulge (Stavelot area), around the western tip near St Hubert, back east along the south shoulder past Bastogne, then along the Our, Sauer and Moselle to the Saar, leaving the east edge near 6.84E 49.21N. Gaps where grid labels, symbols or hatching cross the line were bridged by eye. Points east of 6.7E use one grid line for scale, so they may be off by about 0.01.
